defs.def: almost; not quite; not completely 几乎；差不多；将近

ex.s: The blinding whiteout made driving nearly impossible.
ex.t: 令人眩目的白茫一片让驾驶几乎无法进行。

ex.s: Riders have printed nearly 20,000 short stories and poems since the program was launched last March.
ex.t: 自去年3月该项目启动以来，乘客已打印了近两万篇短篇故事和诗歌。

ex.s: In a world where nearly 800 million people a year go hungry, “food waste goes against the moral grain,” as Elizabeth Royte writes in this month’s cover story.
ex.t: 在一个每年近8亿人挨饿的世界里，"食物浪费违背道德准则，"伊丽莎白·罗伊特在本月封面故事中写道。

ex.s: For nearly a decade now, Merebeth has been a self-employed pet transport specialist.
ex.t: 近十年来，梅雷贝斯一直是一名个体经营的宠物运输专家。

ex.s: New researchers found that middle-aged women who were physically fit could be nearly 90 percent less likely to develop dementia in later life, and as they did, it came on a decade later than less sporty women.
ex.t: 新研究发现，身体健硕的中年女性晚年患痴呆症的可能性低近90%，而且即使患病，也比不爱运动的女性晚十年发作。

ex.s: I see our lizard, raw and nearly new.
ex.t: 我看到我们的蜥蜴崭新而近乎重生。

ex.s: More than half（53 percent）have breakfast alone and nearly half（46 percent）have lunch by themselves.
ex.t: 超过一半（53%）的人独自吃早餐，近半数（46%）的人独自吃午餐。

ex.s: In the Sierra high country, the number of big trees has fallen by more than 55 percent; in parts of southern California the decline was nearly 75 percent.
ex.t: 在内华达高海拔地区，大树的数量下降了超过55%；在南加州部分地区，下降幅度接近75%。

ex.s: Corn production has jumped nearly 125 percent over   62   past 25 years, while rice has increased only 7 percent.
ex.t: 玉米产量在____62____过去25年里增长了近125%，而水稻只增长了7%。

ex.s: They were seen as nearly worthless.
ex.t: 他们被视为几乎毫无价值。

ex.s: The government spent nearly 30 years coming up with a plan to reintroduce the wolvers.
ex.t: 政府花了近30年时间才制定出重新引入狼的计划。

ex.s: Last year the Foundation reported that nearly 60% of 7- to 12-year-olds said they felt tired during the day, and 15% said they had fallen asleep at school.
ex.t: 去年，该基金会报告称，近60%的7至12岁儿童说他们白天感到疲倦，15%说他们在学校里睡着了。

ex.s: But herd immunity works only when nearly the whole herd joins in.
ex.t: 但只有当几乎整个群体都参与进来时，群体免疫才会起作用。

ex.s: Saint-Exupéry nearly died, and wandered around for four days before being rescued.
ex.t: 圣埃克苏佩里差点丧命，他在获救前游荡了四天。

ex.s: Nearly every job is potentially at risk in the long run.
ex.t: 从长远来看，几乎每一份工作都潜在地面临风险。

ex.s: The outer side of the crater sloped southward and the Earth, which was low in the southern sky, was nearly full, so that the entire crater-slope was brightly lit.
ex.t: 环形山的外侧向南倾斜，位于南方天空低处的地球几乎是满的，因此整个环形山坡被照得明亮。

ex.s: Superficially, these two men, whose lives were separated in time by nearly 1,500 years, were polar opposites.
ex.t: 从表面上看，这两个生活年代相隔近1500年的人是截然相反的。

ex.s: I was nearly as excited about it this morning as the children, whom I found all looking through the window at the magic outside and talking away as excitedly as if Christmas had suddenly come round again.
ex.t: 今天早上我几乎和孩子们一样兴奋，发现他们都在透过窗户看着外面神奇的世界，激动地说个不停，仿佛圣诞节突然又来临了。

与 几乎 刚出现的
早餐 独自 与 几乎
